title: Mold Remediation Tier Assignment and Funding Source
content:
**1. Tier.** The tier is fixed at booking from the growth location and the visible growth area in each tier's entry gate: HVAC growth selects HVAC System Mold Remediation, attic or crawlspace growth selects Attic and Crawlspace Mold Remediation, and growth in a living area or basement selects Spot, Limited, Standard or Extensive Mold Remediation by area.

| Tier | Growth location | Visible growth area (sq ft) |
|---|---|---|
| Spot Mold Remediation | Living area or basement | 1 to 10 |
| Limited Mold Remediation | Living area or basement | 11 to 30 |
| Standard Mold Remediation | Living area or basement | 31 to 100 |
| Extensive Mold Remediation | Living area or basement | 101 or more |
| Attic and Crawlspace Mold Remediation | Attic or crawlspace | 1 or more |
| HVAC System Mold Remediation | HVAC | 0 or more |

**2. Company warranty funding: secondary damage.** A job whose linked water job ended with the drying outcome dry standard met, and whose opened date is no later than the secondary damage warranty days after that water job's drying complete date, is funded as company warranty. A water job that ended with the drying outcome customer release carries no secondary damage warranty.

**3. Company warranty funding: regrowth.** A job that re-remediates regrowth in the area of an earlier mold job of the company, opened no later than that earlier job's remediation warranty days after its cleared date, is funded as company warranty. The warranty tier and day count are the earlier job's own.

**4. Effect of company warranty funding.** A company warranty job is performed at no charge: no charge line of any kind is booked on it, and it is never billed to a claim file.

**5. Other funding.** Otherwise the job is insurance claim funded when it is linked to a claim file of the same customer that is not denied or withdrawn, and self-pay when it is not.

## Evidence and counting

- Clauses 2 and 3 are decided on system records read at booking, never on the customer's account of the history: for clause 2, the Water Damage Mitigation job linked to the mold job, its drying outcome and its drying complete date; for clause 3, the earlier mold job the new job names, its cleared date and its tier.
- The warranty days are counted in calendar days from the drying complete date (clause 2) or the earlier job's cleared date (clause 3). An opened date on the last day of the period is no later than that day and qualifies; an opened date on the following day does not.

| Hypothetical case | Funding |
|---|---|
| Linked water job dry standard met, mold job opened on the last day of the 60-day period | Company warranty |
| Same water job, mold job opened the day after that last day; linked claim file approved | Insurance claim |
| Linked water job ended under customer release; no claim file | Self-pay |
| Regrowth in the area of an earlier Limited Mold Remediation job, opened within that job's 180 days after its cleared date | Company warranty, on the earlier job's tier and day count |
| Linked claim file denied | Self-pay |
